name: The Sovereign Provision: How Axiom Built the Future
description: A lavishly produced Axiom-commissioned documentary tracing the corponation's role in stabilizing the Great Lakes corridor after nation-state collapse, framing displacement of Shelf populations as 'voluntary urban optimization.' Directed by licensed studio Vantablack subsidiary Aurum Frame, featuring exclusive Spire access and orchestral scoring by a 140-piece synthetic ensemble. Critics who viewed unlicensed copies noted the film omits the Cartography Hearings entirely and replaces the Ward Nine substrate trials with a segment on Axiom's charitable hydration initiatives.
cultural_impact: Cemented the phrase 'urban optimization' as standard euphemism in M88 civic language, a term now used without irony even by its victims.
story_hooks: A junior Axiom archivist discovers the original unedited source footage was never destroyed and is still indexed on a legacy server she has clearance to access.
A Shelf community organizer is prosecuted for distributing annotated counter-edits of the documentary that splice in survivor testimony.
The documentary's director, now elderly, anonymously contacts an underground journalist claiming she was coerced into omitting three key sequences.
